record_info.statute: 5 Del. C. ch. 23, subch. II (SB 18, 85 Del. Laws c. 338)

license_required.quote: A person may not engage in the business of money transmission

bond_structure.quote: The Commissioner shall determine the principal sum of the bond
bond_structure.note: Commissioner sets the amount between $100,000 and $500,000

net_worth_structure.quote: a tangible net worth of the greater of $100,000 or 3% of total assets for the first $100 million
net_worth_structure.note: Percentage changes by asset bracket (3%, 2%, 0.5%); same structure as Texas 152.351

net_worth_min_usd.quote: a tangible net worth of the greater of $100,000 or 3% of total assets for the first $100 million

application_fee_usd.note: Paid at application; a separate $230 annual license fee is due on approval (2307(g))

renewal_fee_usd.note: Plus $4.60 per authorized delegate location after the first

decision_days.quote: the Commissioner shall promptly notify the applicant in writing of the date on which the application is deemed complete
decision_days.note: No deadline to approve or deny. The only day count is a 30-day deadline to send written notice after a denial.

exemptions.quote: This chapter does not apply to any of the following:
exemptions.note: 14 exemptions in 2305(a), plus authorized delegates in 2304(b)(1)
